author: Marshall Ray
text: We've had the pleasure of working with Taylor Sewer many times, and they're wonderful every time. They do great work, fair prices, and are great with scheduling. There's 2 stories I can think of where they were able to fix issues that other companies couldn't, which speaks for itself. Highly recommended. Thanks for taking care of us!

author: Ken
text: Bryan Sommer from Taylor Sewer did an amazing job with the narration with the video of our Sewer lateral line. He sent the video to the city. The city inspector showed up an hour after video was sent in. THANK YOU BRYAN! Awesome job.

author: Nora Kelley
text: I had a great experience with them. I have a 100 year old city house and I was really nervous of what might be going on with my plumbing issue. They were super quick to respond to my initial inquiry and prompt on scheduling. Brian was so kind and knowledgeable and immediately made me comfortable. I would highly recommend their company!

author: Ryan James
text: Fantastic service from Taylor Sewer Service. Brian is extremely knowledgeable, reliable, fair, and honest. I would highly recommend them and would do business with them every time, given the choice.

author: Walt Winters
text: I've used Brian many times on different properties. The latest was today. I have also used others when Brian is booked out for longer than I can wait. But I always prefer Brian and now is son is working with him so service times are good. He is the most honest business person I've encountered. Always fair prices and he guarantees his work. He will make sure the job is well done before leaving any job site.
